complexity_ledger.narrative: specs/results/scorecards/reading-discipline/GOAL-product-round/RD-03/RESULT.md RD-03 is the EVALUATION ticket closing `reading-discipline`. It decides all four epic goals and it changes no program behaviour: 17 findings filed, ZERO fixed, no artifact tree touched, and the one suite failure the round caused left red rather than repaired. WHAT WAS MEASURED. Twelve blind judges at two model tiers scored RD-06's six subjects as three before/after pairs, 24 cards. D2 anchor 3 became reachable on the product side for the first time: eight judges saw a code change and eight awarded it; four saw none and four refused it; NOT ONE split on the size of the delta. `D2 = 2`, constant on 35 of 35 cards of `ab_quota_ledger` and the figure an entire predecessor epic was opened on, is retired -- not because the card changed (the served rubric digest is byte-identical) but because a subject was finally given a before. WHAT IT COST TO BELIEVE. Eight judges independently reported that the complexity descriptor cannot see what they scored (19 of 21 axes byte-identical on one pair; `branch_points` moving the wrong way on the other). D2 split by judge tier for the first time in the record, downstream of a D4 split that is a disagreement about what "model-derived" means. The sweep count moved 22 figures to REFUTED without a document changing, because the card population grew. THE FOUR GOALS: `GOAL-product-round` decided with three verdicts and a reason each (Q1 NOT ANSWERABLE on this fixture and now measured to be so; Q2 NO for the prompt, YES for the revision pass; Q3 YES, on instrument reach rather than code quality). `GOAL-scope-loss-catchable` MET, reported with all three known bounds on its instrument. `GOAL-tags-earn-their-place` MET on deletion and not on admission, with the `opus`-only limit now CLOSED and the closure's own bound stated. `GOAL-apparatus-priced` CONFIRMED LOAD-BEARING on re-run evidence, with the pricing instrument shown entailed at 0 of 10. 7 of the 17 findings are PRODUCT SURFACE, against zero in each of the last two epics. Full reasoning, every rejection, and the sealed predictions scored (4 of 14 falsified) are in the RESULT.md named above.

refinement.detail: SEARCHED, FOUND NONE, AND THE REASON IS THE TICKET'S ROLE. RD-03 is `role: evaluation` with `model_delta_expectation: none expected` and `desired_actions: []`. It adds no action, no variable and no state to any TLA+ model; its `implementation_scope` is `specs/results/scorecards/` and `NEXT-EPIC.md`. The whole-program model is byte-unchanged between the branch point `8f3741f` and this tip -- `git diff 8f3741f..HEAD -- specs/program_model specs/tickets/RD-03/desired` is empty apart from the workflow scaffold `start_ticket.py` wrote. There is no representation to refine because none was added. A refinement recommendation WAS available and was refused rather than unfound: this round measured that the complexity descriptor cannot see the only simplification it scored (`RD-03-DF-08`, eight independent judges), and the obvious move is to add an axis for stored-versus-derived duplication. Refused as `MF-020` in its purest form -- adding an axis so that this round's subjects score better is tuning the thermometer to the result. Filed for the owner instead, with the condition that any such axis ships with a seeded case where it moves the WRONG way.

ticket.objective: RE-SCOPED AT schedule_revision 2 TO POINT AT THE PRODUCT. 100 of 108 findings in this epic family touch only the measurement apparatus and the last two epics produced ZERO product findings. A fourth consecutive apparatus evaluation would tell us our checks have bounds, which we know. TWO PARTS, AND THE SECOND IS THE HEADLINE. (1) DECIDE THE THREE APPARATUS GOALS, which were agreed before dispatch and may not be silently dropped. Most of their evidence is already in hand from RD-01, RD-02, RD-04 and RD-05. GOAL-scope-loss-catchable must be reported WITH BOTH KNOWN BOUNDS on its instrument -- keyed on \bD[1-5]\b, and REFUTED for a true figure whose qualifier falls outside a 3-word window -- either of which can move the count in either direction. GOAL-tags-earn-their-place must report that the separation is opus-only, n = 0 in sonnet, and that TWO candidate values were REFUSED admission. GOAL-apparatus-priced is decided LOAD-BEARING, with the pricing instrument that blessed two epics of free removals shown to be ENTAILED -- 0 of 9 gap mutants could have priced their removal. (2) USE THE INSTRUMENTS ON THE PRODUCT. Answer the three original questions with a card that now demonstrably measures: do model-derived cases catch bugs hand-written tests miss; does the prompt produce simpler code at equal behaviour, NOW THAT D2 ANCHOR 3 IS REACHABLE AND NEVER WAS BEFORE; and does the effectful vs ports-and-adapters choice change what validation can see, now that the choice is taggable. That last one uses the architecture tag rather than building it. FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING.
